title: Contributing to Accessibility Datasets: Reflections on Sharing Study Data by Blind People
benchmark_measurement: Participants' comfort level with sharing their religious affiliation as part of a dataset.
findings: Participants raised concerns about sharing their religious affiliation, identifying it as a demographic data point they would not want to share.
